import pandas as pd

# Read input file
input_path = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Compute missingness for each indicator
missingness_data = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0.0
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    missingness_data.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': int(missing_count),
        'missing_rate': round(missing_rate, 6),
        'kept': kept
    })

# Create missingness report
missingness_df = pd.DataFrame(missingness_data)
missingness_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Create selected matrix with only kept indicators
kept_indicator_cols = [col for col in indicator_cols if missingness_df[missingness_df['indicator'] == col]['kept'].iloc[0]]
selected_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicator_cols
selected_df = df[selected_cols]
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>
